resolution.tooltip: Long side the frames are resized to for RVM, which gives one feature per 16x16 patch. Higher tracks finer shapes and needs more VRAM.

reference_frame.tooltip: Frame the reference mask belongs to. Frames before it are tracked backwards.

top_k.tooltip: Most similar memory patches each patch reads its label from.

temperature.tooltip: Softmax temperature of the matching: lower trusts the best match more.

track_features.tooltip: encoder: RVM's per-frame patch tokens (most reliable). recurrent: the state RVM hands to the keyer (causal, so frames before reference_frame get a reversed-time pass). both: the two similarities averaged.

reference_mask.tooltip: Subject mask on reference_frame, white = subject. One mask, or one per frame (the one at reference_frame is used). Without it tracked_mask is all zeros.

output_tooltips: RVM recurrent features as colors (3-component PCA, fitted once per clip).
Change of RVM's per-frame patch encoding since the previous frame, scaled by the clip's 99th percentile (frame 0 is 0, a still shot stays near 0).
The reference mask propagated to every frame (soft, patch resolution), 1 = subject. All zeros when no reference_mask is connected.
CorridorKey2MotionTracking.name: CorridorKey2MotionTracking
CorridorKey2MotionTracking.description: Shows how RVM, the keyer's recurrent video model, follows the clip: its features as a PCA color video (an object that keeps its color is tracked consistently), a motion-energy mask (how much each patch changed since the previous frame) and, given a subject mask on one frame, that mask propagated forwards and backwards through the clip by feature matching.
